authority_wording_corrections.as_written_by_authority: Tiga aspek pengurusan pembajaan untuk kontraktor.
authority_wording_corrections.as_applied: Tiga aspek pengurusan racun untuk kontraktor.
authority_wording_corrections.basis: The screen Bariah is inserting sits inside the Racun sequence, is titled 'Racun — aspek pengurusan untuk kontraktor', and enumerates three pesticide-specific aspects: Perundangan Dan Pelesenan, Keselamatan Dan Kesihatan (HSE), Pengurusan Risiko. 'Pembajaan' is fertilising. The Baja equivalent screen in the same table reads 'Lima aspek pengurusan pembajaan untuk kontraktor', which is where the word came from. The count also differs — three here, five there.
authority_wording_corrections.what_happens_if_wrong: If Bariah meant fertilising, the inserted screen belongs in the Baja sequence rather than the Racun sequence and the whole insertion point moves. The original wording is preserved above so the correction can be undone from this record alone.
authority_wording_corrections.confirmation_required_from: Bariah — one line confirming the screen is about racun.
